name: GameLib 1.0.0
body:
## GameLib 1.0.0

- **Steam platform support**: Browse, install, and launch your full Steam library from within GameLib — no need to switch to the Steam client
- **CrossOver & Proton integration**: Steam games on macOS run via CrossOver; Linux users benefit from Steam's own Proton configuration per game
- **Heroic → GameLib rebrand**: Unified launcher identity across the UI, tray, config paths, and logs
- **Unified library**: Epic, GOG, Amazon, and Steam games appear together in one view with consistent install/launch/uninstall actions
- **Steam account management**: Sign in via QR code (mobile Steam app) or username/password with SteamGuard support

Built on Heroic 2.22.0 — [see upstream release notes](https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/HeroicGamesLauncher/releases/tag/v2.22.0)
